test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends are sitting around a circular table facing the center of the table. Abhishek is sitting to the immediate left of Sharad. Joseph is to the immediate right of Wasim. Vishal is third to the left of Wasim. Who is sitting between Joseph and Abhishek?
solution:
**Total friends:** five.

(1) Joseph is to the immediate right of Wasim. 

(2) Vishal is third to the left of Wasim. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aaca70bd351c0ad25b21d0a906678419597d3189fb7dde11f4c99e9b8650bd5.png] 

(3) Abhishek is sitting to the immediate left of Sharad.

Therefore, the final seating arrangement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11a977398cdc6a9460820df0d80091d9f65fb9ad9fcd4ecd022660d4fbe714e6.png] 

Hence, Vishal is sitting between Joseph and Abhishek.
